portal_hypertension.title: Association of Hemostatic Blood Product Transfusion With Clinical Outcomes in Esophageal Variceal Bleeding.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Butt MA, Bloom H, Aamer S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：静脉曲张出血是由于门静脉高压而不是原发性止血功能障碍引起的。 临床提示：然而，这些患者的血小板计数经常较低且国际标准化比值 (INR) 值升高，因此尽管多个肝脏协会的指导，他们仍经常在入院时接受输血
portal_hypertension.abstract: Variceal bleeds occur due to portal hypertension and not primary hemostatic dysfunction. However, these patients frequently have low platelet counts and elevated international normalized ratio (INR) values, for which they often receive transfusions upon admission despite guidance from multiple liver societies. We performed a retrospective analysis using the TriNetX United States Collaborative Network. Cohorts were defined based on transfusion of fresh frozen plasma (FFP), platelets, or cryoprecipitate within 72 h of variceal bleeding diagnosis.
